entities.description: A retail product line. Its variants{} map holds the purchasable items, each of which is also a first-class `item` entity.

fields.name: variants
fields.description: Dictionary of variants indexed by variant ID

entities.description: One purchasable variant of a product (a specific colour/size/...), promoted out of products[].variants so it can be looked up directly.

fields.name: options
fields.description: Dictionary of option names to values (e.g. {'color': 'blue', 'size': 'large'})

fields.name: available
fields.description: Whether this variant is currently in stock

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: ID of the product this item is a variant of.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Name of the parent product, denormalized onto the item so it can be filtered without a join. Filter key only -- never projected.

entities.description: A customer, with their address, payment methods and order history.

fields.name: payment_methods
fields.description: Dictionary of payment methods indexed by payment method ID

fields.name: orders
fields.description: List of order IDs associated with this user

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: Flattened copy of name.first_name so a ledger_read `where` can filter on it. Filter key only -- never projected; the nested name{} object is what tools return.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Flattened copy of name.last_name so a ledger_read `where` can filter on it. Filter key only -- never projected; the nested name{} object is what tools return.

fields.name: zip
fields.description: Flattened copy of address.zip so a ledger_read `where` can filter on it. Filter key only -- never projected; the nested address{} object is what tools return.

entities.description: A customer order and its lifecycle: items, fulfillments, payment history, and the cancel/return/exchange fields written by the post-purchase tools.

fields.name: cancel_reason
fields.description: Reason for cancelling the order. Should be 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'

fields.name: exchange_payment_method_id
fields.description: Payment method ID for the exchange

fields.name: return_payment_method_id
fields.description: Payment method ID for the return
